Where are protons and neutrons located in an atom?
cards.back: In the nucleus (center of the atom).

cards.front: What is the atomic number (Z) of an element?
cards.back: Number of protons in the nucleus. Determines the element's identity.

cards.front: What is the mass number (A) of an atom?
cards.back: Total number of protons + neutrons in the nucleus.
Neutrons = Mass number - Atomic number = 14 - 6 = 8 neutrons
Atoms of the same element (same protons) with different numbers of neutrons (different mass numbers).

What happens when an atom loses electrons?
cards.back: Forms a positive ion (cation). More protons than electrons.

cards.front: What happens when an atom gains electrons?
cards.back: Forms a negative ion (anion). More electrons than protons.

cards.front: What is the charge of a Mg²⁺ ion? How many electrons does it have? (Mg Z=12)
How are elements arranged in the periodic table?
cards.back: In order of increasing atomic number (proton number). Elements in same group have similar properties.
